bio.text: Deva Simmons is running with no party affiliation for Florida's 18th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Simmons graduated from Erasmus Hall High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Columbia College in 1990 and a graduate degree from Adelphi University in 1995, and was retired as of 2026.
According to the Ballotpedia survey, Simmons was born and raised in Brooklyn, moved to Florida in 1995 and has lived in Polk County since 2002, and has worked in education for more than two decades.
The candidate has served on the board of the Boys & Girls Club of Lakeland.
